title: viewer-linked acadrust fork and round-trip claim boundary
mode: Broader primary-source codec-lineage and evidence-claim review
scope: Screen a newly surfaced viewer-linked DWG/DXF codec repository for an independent implementation lineage.
Reconcile its advertised DWG/DXF matrix and 208/208 round-trip claim with the existing acadrust-family comparator ceiling.
Separate primitive SAT/SAB authoring claims from embedded modeler preservation and independent B-rep semantics.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.

method.kind: Mutable primary repository README and existing route-register reconciliation
method.evidenceRule: Repository capability statements and aggregate round-trip claims are candidate-selection evidence only until revision, input matrix, expected-value lineage, unsupported dispositions, and consumer acceptance are independently inspected. Same-family forks do not add independent codec votes.

evidence.observed: The fork repository describes itself as an MPL-2.0 acadrust fork for a DWG viewer build. Its README advertises ASCII/Binary DXF and DWG read/write, 41 entity types, primitive SAT/SAB authoring, and a 208/208 DWG round-trip claim across 26 entity types and 8 versions. The 208/208 statement appears under the 0.2.9 changelog while the current package example is 0.3.4; the 0.3.4 note says round-trip coverage was expanded without restating the denominator or comparison method.
evidence.limits: The README does not identify the sample provenance, independent expected-value source, unsupported/skipped denominator, exact tested source or binary hash, or native consumer audit. This screen did not inspect the fork's test implementation or prove that tests are absent; the mutable README and aggregate claim alone do not establish complete support or semantics.
evidence.planUse: Record as a same-family alias under the existing provisional acadrust route, not an independent peer. Keep status SCREENED_NOT_ADMITTED until an exact profile, immutable artifact, test-input provenance, oracle, and result disposition can be audited. Do not infer general ACIS import or B-rep correctness from primitive authoring or round trips.

evidence.observed: Extended the existing PAR-07/S8 lineage and evidence-ceiling guidance to include viewer-linked acadrust forks and version-ambiguous aggregate round-trip claims. Existing source-entity/owner/carrier/parser/shape/analytic/consumer stages remain unchanged.
evidence.limits: No production code, tests, fixtures, or dependencies were changed or run. No new finding, top-level subplan, comparator admission, support claim, or validation cadence was added.
evidence.planUse: Continue local fast-gated work under existing owners. If peer provenance cannot be pinned, record NOT_RUN and self-unblock rather than install or depend on the fork.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-07/S8 comparator register: cluster viewer-linked acadrust forks and applications with their actual codec lineage.
3D evidence: primitive SAT/SAB authoring and entity counts do not promote imported-body, AcDs association, topology, or analytic semantic support.
Comparator admission: resolve exact artifact, test corpus, oracle, dispositions, and consumer route before considering a peer run.
